title: Fir Cone
wikitext:
{{{{{1|Seeds Infobox}}} |image = Fir Cone |Growth = Varies |Season = {{Season|All}} |Sell Price = 5 |Crafting = {{Name|Seed Cookie}} }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Trees|Wild Tree]] seed that grows into a [[Fir Tree]]. It can be planted anywhere outdoors and cannot be planted in a [[Stardew:Greenhouse|Greenhouse]]. Like other [[Stardew:Trees#Common Trees|vanilla common trees]], there are 5 stages of growth, with approximately a 20% chance of increasing in growth each night during {{Season|Spring}}, {{Season|Summer}}, or {{Season|Fall}}. The median time to maturity is about 18 days, with over 90% of seeds maturing in less than 32 growing days. [[Stardew:Trees#Common Trees|Stardew Valley Wiki - Common Trees]]  The use of [[Stardew:Tree Fertilizer|Tree Fertilizer]] reduces growth time to one night per stage, even in {{Season|Winter}}. Fir Cones cannot be purchased, but they can be obtained by chopping down existing Fir Trees. They are used to craft [[Seed Cookie]]. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Summary== {{#lst:Fir Tree|stages}} ==Recipes== ===Crafting=== {{CraftingRecipes|header}} {{:Seed Cookie|CraftingRow}} {{CraftingRecipes|footer}} {{clear}}
